Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's it from the coverage of this game. Zimbabwe have got the consolation win which will surely boost their confidence. The Aussies though have won the series and the trophy has been handed out to Aaron Finch. The team soon joins the skipper and they all pose for a team picture. Zimbabwe will go straight to the T20 World Cup where they will be playing against Ireland on the 17th of October. The Aussies will be up against New Zealand for a three-match ODI series which will begin on 6th September 2022 at Cazaly's Stadium, Cairns. The first ball will be at 9.50 am IST (4.20 am GMT). But the build-up begins much sooner. Till then it's a goodbye. Cheers!

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia is in for a chat. He says that Zimbabwe got it right with the ball in the morning. Mentions if you don't turn up in an International sport then one could get beaten on any given day. Says that they had an outside chance to get back with the ball but it wasn't their day. Mentions David Warner has been there whenever the team needed him. Also praises Josh Hazlewood and Mitchell Starc for their effort and says that they both are world-class bowlers.

Regis Chakabva, the captain of Zimbabwe says that it was great to see how they started the match this morning. Adds that the boys showed a good fighting spirit and kept it real tight. Informs that they will head back home. Further adds that they will start with their fitness training first and later start their preparations for the T20 World Cup.

Adam Zampa wins the Player of the Series award for his exceptional spells over the course of the seires. Says that there were obviously questionmarks over his preapertions and states that playing in The Hundred helped him a lot. Adds that it feels good to be back in Aussie colours. Mentions it is just about getting game time, getting to the crease and it has helped him progess throughout this series.

Ryan Burl wins the Man of the Match award for his incredible spell of 3-0-10-5. He says that this win was massively important and he is unhappy that he couldn't take his team across the line. Adds that from this win they will take a lot of confidence for the upcoming World Cup matches.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the game, Zimbabwe were excellent with the ball. They were on song from the word go and had Australia reeling at 31/3 inside the first Powerplay. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and got bundled out at 141. It could've been worse if not for David Warner's knock of 94. It was Ryan Burl who caused havoc with the ball and played a massive role in bowling out Australia. During the chase, the Zimbabwe batters were really brave. They played with grit and determination and eventually got over the line.

Australia did give a run for their money but it was always going to be a challenge to defend a low score! Josh Hazlewood stood out with the ball for them with his three-fer. Apart from Adam Zampa all the bowlers took a wicket apiece. The bowlers did really well to pile up presssure with timely wickets but in the end they did not have much in their kitty to for.

All smiles in the Zimbabwe camp then. The target was low but they were put under pressure several times from the Aussie bowlers but in the end it is their skipper, Regis Chakabva who played a gritty captain's knock and got his side over the line. The openers Tadiwanashe Marumani and Takudzwanashe Kaitano set a solid platform with a solid stand of 38 runs for the opening wicket. Wesley Madhevere and Sean Williams fell on successive deliveries which put their team on the back foot. Sikandar Raza came in at a crucial stage but yet again slipped out to a short ball. Then Regis Chakabva and Tony Munyonga got their side closer to the finish line with their match-saving stand. Later the skipper applied the finishing touches to record a historic win.

A special, special win for Zimbabwe! This is their first ODI win against Australia in Australia. A huge achievement for the visitors and they walk back with a consolation win. The Aussies fought really hard but it was always going to be tricky to defend a below-par target.
Fuller and on off, Brad Evans drives it to covers for one. Zimbabwe win by 3 wickets!

On a length and on off, Regis Chakabva looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball did carry a bit but it was wide of the fielder at backward point. They collect one. Scores are level now!
A low full toss outside off, Regis Chakabva looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On a length and on leg, Brad Evans gently flicks it to backward square leg for one. 2 runs needed now.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads, Regis Chakabva misses his flick. It brushes the pads and rolls out to the leg side. They collect a leg bye.
Around off, pushed out to safety.

Slightly shorter and on off, Regis Chakabva punches it to covers for one.

Fuller one, on off, Regis Chakabva blocks it away.

Goes fuller and on middle, this is defended back towards the bowler.

Fuller and on off, this is defended solidly.

A low full toss on off, Regis Chakabva eases it to mid off.

FOUR! Fuller and on off, Ryan Burl knocks it through mid on as the ball races away for a boundary. Excellent placement!

On a length and on leg, Ryan Burl gently flicks it to the fielder at square leg. Dot.

On off this time, Regis Chakabva drives it ut finds the fielder at covers.

The ball sneaks under his blade and rattles the stumps. Zimbabwe in a spot od bother, although they aren't far away from the finish line. Is there a twist in the tale?

The Aussies need to find a way to break this stand and get the tail in. Zimbabwe need under 30 runs and the current pair would be hoping to keep the runs ticking rather taking the aggressive path.

An inswinger from Josh Hazlewood, slightly shorter, Regis Chakabva leaves it alone.
Fuller one this time, Regis Chakabva flicks it to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Regis Chakabva eases it to the fielder at covers.

Outside off, pushed to point.

Outside off this time, Regis Chakabva eases it to the cover fielder.

Tossed up, on off, defended out.

On off, defended.
Fuller again, Tony Munyonga scoops it towards fine leg for a brace.

Good length this time, Tony Munyonga defends it to the leg side. Four dots now.

Change. Josh Hazlewood (6-1-19-3) is back into the attack now.

it is much quicker, full and on off. Tony Munyonga looks to sweep it away but it lobs off the gloves and lands safely at gully.

Alex Carey calls for it as soon as it goes in the air. He makes good ground, remains steady and takes a good catch. Zimbabwe are falling apart here.

A single now as this is driven down to long off.

OUT! CAUGHT! A huge blow for Zimbabwe. Sikandar Raza walks back on just 8. It is an off cutter from Stoinis, around middle. Sikandar Raza is not left with much room. He still goes for the pull and does not middle it. It goes off the top-edge and flies towards deep square leg. Mitchell Starc settles in the deep and takes a sharp catch. Regis Chakabva is the new man in for the visitors.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Marcus Stoinis

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, on the pads, Tadiwanashe Marumani flicks it to mid-wicket for one more.
Raza goes back and Stoinis follows him with a full one. Raza pushes it to mid off and gets across for a quick single. David Warner scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end but Raza is safely in.
Fraction short, down leg. Tadiwanashe Marumani drags his pull to deep square leg. They take one.
Starc goes for the yorker but ends up dishing a low full toss. Tadiwanashe Marumani taps it down to long on. The batters take three before Warner cuts it out.
Swing and a miss! Starc serves a length ball, outside off. Marumani looks to heaves it through the line but misses.

FOUR! EDGY! A length ball, around off. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to drive it away. It takes a thick outside edge and flies through the gap at cover-point. No chance for the fielder in the deep. Boundary!
Starc hurls a full-length ball, on the pads. Raza nurdles it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
Good length, wide of off, left alone.
WIDE! Mitchell Starc errs in his line this time. It is full, down leg. Raza lets it be. Wide called.

Change. Mitchell Starc (3-0-16-0) is back on now.

Stoinis serves it on a good length, outside off. Raza has no shot to offer.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.

Short ball, A bit of a mix-up but all safe in the end! It is a length ball, outside off. Tadiwanashe Marumani punches it to point. Tadiwanashe Marumani calls for a single but Raza denies at first but they cross eventually.

This one is again drifting down leg on a fuller length, Tadiwanashe Marumani comes down the track and is late in his shot. It goes to the right of the keeper off the thigh pad. There is a stifled appeal but no interest.
It is full, drifting down leg. Tadiwanashe Marumani fails to flick it away. It goes to fine leg off the pads. They collect two leg byes.

Drinks! Sikandar Raza looks in some trouble here as he calls for a physio. It looks like a back spasm. Hopefully it does not affect his innings here. So, Zimbabwe were off to a good start but they lost Takudzwanashe Kaitano in the ninth over. Josh Hazlewood came on after that and took two back to back wickets and got the Aussies back into the game. Sikandar Raza looks good to start again. Marcus Stoinis comes into the attack.
Josh Hazlewood almost gets another wicket here. He pitches it up, outside off. Raza looks to block it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! This should help settle her nerves! 50 up for Zimbawe. Back-of-a-length ball, around off. Sikandar Raza gives himself some room and cuts it over backward point. It races away to the fence.
Full length, Raza presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
A length ball, outside off. Raza blocks it to covers. Zimbabwe don't have any pressure from the run rate. The batters need to choose their shot carefully.
Swing and a miss! A short ball this time, on off. Sikandar Raza looks to heave it across the line but misses. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.

Sikandar Raza is the new batter. Josh Hazlewood is on a hat-trick here.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Australia are back in the contest. Josh Hazlewood strikes again. He is on a Hat Trick now. It a short ball, on the bodyline. The ball gets big on Sean Williams. It flies off the top of the blade and lobs towards the keeper. Alex Carey comes forward and takes a sitter.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Sean Williams walks in next.

It goes straight to Ashton Agar who manages to hold onto it. Zimbabwe lose their second now. Can Australia build on this?

Swing and a miss. This one lands outside off and on a length, Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to loft it but misses. Close!
On a length and on off, Tadiwanashe Marumani eases it to the right of the bowler.
Slightly shorter and just outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to defend it but misses.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Good length and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani stands firm and drills it through long off for a boundary.
On a length and outside leg, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick it but the ball hits his thigh as the ball goes into the gloves of the keeper.
On a length this time, this is defended back towards the bowler.
Josh Hazlewood bowls it slightly shorter, Tadiwanashe Marumani fends it to point. Dot.
On a length and on leg, Tadiwanashe Marumani eases it towards the leg side.
Good length and on off, defended out.
On a length and on leg, Tadiwanashe Marumani flicks it through a diving fielder at square leg who chases it back. They collect three runs.
Touch fuller and on leg, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick it but gets his pads towards the leg side. Dot.
On a length again, just outside of with some swing, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to defend it but isses.
On a length and on off, defended out.
Slightly shorter with some extra bounce, Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to defend it but gets his glove. The ball carries towards backward square leg and falls in no mans land. They collect one.
Slightly shorter around middle and leg, slower too, Takudzwanashe Kaitano awkwardly pulls it to backward square leg for one.
Another dot ball as this is defended to the off side.
On a length and on leg, Takudzwanashe Kaitano flicks it to the fielder at short covers. Dot.
Slightly shorter with some extra bounce, Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to block it but misses.
Fuller again and down the leg side, Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to block it but misses. The ball hits his pads. A stifled appeal turned down.
Goes fuller and outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to block it but gets an inside edge towards the right of the keeper. They scamper through for a quick single.
It will be Josh Hazlewood to start with the second new ball.
FOUR! Good start for Zimbabwe in the first over. On a length and outside off, Takudzwanashe Kaitano slaps it through point for a boundary.
On a length and on off, this is blocked towards the mid off fielder.
Mitchell Starc bowls it on a length and down the middle, Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it back towards the bowler.
Fuller again, on middle, Takudzwanashe Kaitano defends it solidly.
FOUR! Good shot. Goes fuller and on leg, Takudzwanashe Kaitano just gives it a fine tickle as the ball races away the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc starts with a length ball outside off, Takudzwanashe Kaitano leaves it alone.
